set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically.

Problem
geomHeatmap lowers a regular scalar field to one Tile per cell (PlotDsl.geomHeatmap -> scaleFillContinuous + geomTile). For dense or repeated fields (e.g. 64x48 to 256x256 grids, many facets or small multiples, interactive redraw) this produces tens of thousands of rect primitives per plot, slow picking indexes and large SVG/PDF output. The raster grob already exists (top-row-first ARGB, nearest/smooth interpolation, SVG base64 PNG, PDF image XObject, cached native images on live backends; docs/backends.md), but no plot-level geom maps a scalar field through a continuous scale to one raster.

Scope
A geomRaster (name open) over ScalarField2D (regular grid, explicit extent): values -> continuous fill scale (existing Palette/ThemePalette, Transform, OobPolicy) -> one RasterImage grob placed at the field extent, with the usual continuous colour legend. Explicit interpolation choice (nearest default). Missing/NaN cells map to a declared missing colour or transparency, never silently to the low end. Global alpha parameter.

Acceptance criteria
1. The same field and scale give the same colours as geomHeatmap at every cell centre (conformance test against the tile path).
2. One device image per layer on every backend; SVG/PDF embed it losslessly; limits.md raster ceilings apply.
3. Legend and scale training behave exactly as for geomHeatmap (shared limits across facets when requested).
4. Missing cells are distinguishable from the minimum colour (test).
5. Picking returns the cell (row, column, value) under a point, via the shared picking contract, without per-cell primitives.
6. Documented in the gallery with a non-square field.

Exclusions
Irregular meshes; resampling or smoothing of the field (the caller supplies values).
set.title: [Intaglio] Raster field geom: draw a ScalarField2D as one raster image with a continuous fill scale and legend
